How to generate a CA certificate with pki
output: pki --gen --type ecdsa --size 256 --outform pem > ca.key && pki --self --ca --lifetime 3650 --in ca.key --dn 'CN=VPN CA, O=Example' --outform pem > ca.crt

instruction: How to generate a server certificate with pki
output: pki --gen --type ecdsa --size 256 --outform pem > server.key && pki --pub --in server.key | pki --issue --cacert ca.crt --cakey ca.key --dn 'CN=server.example.com, O=Example' --san server.example.com --flag serverAuth --flag ikeIntermediate --outform pem > server.crt

instruction: How to generate a client certificate with pki
output: pki --gen --type ecdsa --size 256 --outform pem > client.key && pki --pub --in client.key | pki --issue --cacert ca.crt --cakey ca.key --dn 'CN=client.example.com, O=Example' --san client.example.com --outform pem > client.crt
